snippet.title: DEAD STATION FILES | Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Checkout Demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3687410/Dead_Station_Files/

Hardcore tactical roguelike puzzle about survival during a perfect storm of disasters aboard the space station. 
Explore, adapt, and plan your escape to uncover the truth behind the catastrophe. Or die.
